title: Proof of a Brown-Mol conjecture on subtree roots
summary: The subtree polynomial of a tree is the generating function that enumerates its subtrees according to their orders. Brown and Mol conjectured that every subtree root of a tree of order $n\ge 2$ lies in the disk \[ \left\{z\in\mathbb C: |z|\le 1+\sqrt[n-1]{n-1} \right\}. \] We prove this conjecture by introducing a recursive comparison method based on an extremal problem over integer compositions. We further characterize the equality case: the upper bound is attained if and only if $n$ is even and the tree is the star; in this case the unique boundary root is $-1-\sqrt[n-1]{n-1}$. We also…
